pages_and_sections.name: Home Hero

pages_and_sections.name: Our Story
pages_and_sections.layout: Grid-based bento layout with asymmetric image placements

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0A0A0A base passes APCA standards. Use text-shadow if placed directly over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must use data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-table-cta').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query to disable parallax and kinetic blur if enabled by user.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' via Google Fonts.
Implement the 'Spotlight Cursor' as a fixed pointer-events-none div with a radial-gradient background mapping to mouse coordinates.
For the hero background overlay, use bg-black/60 to ensure the white wordmark remains legible.
Apply the film grain texture using an SVG noise filter or an absolute div with a background image pattern.
Use the exact hex codes provided for the glowing neon effects (#FF9F1C).
Buttons must have the custom border-glow effect detailed in the components section.
Ensure the menu section is a tabbed interface (e.g., Food, Cocktails, Spirits, Wine) with a smooth layout transition.
